verdict.rationale: Proa is a self-hosted Rust web framework that is installed via cargo and runs locally on the user's own Axum server. Nothing in the evidence shows the vendor collecting or processing user data, so an opt-out from AI-model training is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the pack suggests it ships any such data-use control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
